title: Python: Audit lichen package against anti-griefing spec updates
description:
After spec beads under worker6-h4pl are complete, sweep Python implementation:

Check each table/limit in python/src/lichen/:
- Trust/key store bounds (timing, link)
- Fragment context bounds (schc)
- Routing table bounds (rpl)
- Rate limiting in gateway module
- Any dataclass with unbounded dict/list that should be bounded

For each: verify config/default exists with spec-compliant value, or add it.

Depends on: all spec beads under worker6-h4pl
